method: Spans are the false-mute episodes NFL75_PROTECT_001 transcribed and NFL75_BOOTH_HOLD_001 published as sponsor reads the gold file calls program, plus three program episodes from that same listen. Gold stays binary. This file is a second classification. A category was assigned from the first 20 seconds of an episode; a shorter episode is the whole cut. Seconds after that window move with the episode because that is how the 137 and 107 were counted.

classes.promotional_read: A sponsor, campaign, or network read. The heard transcript does not continue into a play call or an editorial sentence. Gold still says program. The consumer scenario treats a mute of these seconds as suppression.
classes.mixed_mention: A sponsor or network line in the same span as football or editorial talk, or a reaction that does not name a read. Gold says program. Both scores still count a mute here as a false mute.
classes.program: Football or editorial programming. Both scores count a mute as a false mute.
